source.manualTitle: Whirlpool Jazz French Door Refrigerator (W10322959B, 19–22 cu ft)

steps.title: Disconnect power
steps.body: Unplug the refrigerator or disconnect power before servicing. Replace all parts and panels before operating.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Disconnect power before servicing. Replace all parts and panels before operating.

steps.title: Continue in Service Test Mode
steps.body: Service Test Mode (S-E) entered. Use Freezer UP/DOWN to select the test number for this procedure.
steps.sourceExcerpt: You are now in the SERVICES TEST operational mode and may use the diagnostic tests.

steps.title: Select Service Test 6
steps.body: In Service Test Mode (S-E), use Freezer UP/DOWN keys until freezer display shows 6. Refrigerator display blank until test is activated.

steps.title: Activate test 6
steps.body: Press Refrigerator UP to toggle damper OPEN (O) or CLOSED (C). Allow 1 minute per position change.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Press Refrigerator UP to toggle damper OPEN (O) or CLOSED (C). Allow 1 minute per position change.

steps.title: Damper opens
steps.body: After 1 minute, does damper move to open position (refrigerator O)?
steps.sourceExcerpt: After 1 minute, does damper move to open position (refrigerator O)?

branches.label: No / fault
branches.oemOutcome: Damper does not move — check motor, linkage, or control output.

steps.title: Damper closes
steps.body: Toggle to closed (C). After 1 minute, does damper fully close?
steps.sourceExcerpt: Toggle to closed (C). After 1 minute, does damper fully close?

branches.label: No / fault
branches.oemOutcome: Damper stuck open or closed — replace damper assembly.

steps.title: Deactivate test 6
steps.body: Leave damper test deactivated before exiting Service Test Mode.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Leave damper test deactivated before exiting Service Test Mode.

steps.title: Replace damper
steps.oemOutcome: Replace electric damper control when it fails to open/close in service test 6.

steps.title: Damper verified
steps.oemOutcome: Damper opens and closes correctly in service test 6.
